description: This file contains utility functions for interacting with a PostgreSQL database using psycopg, including functions for building DSN strings from environment variables, managing database connections, and executing queries with different return types.

methods.name: str _build_dsn_from_env()
methods.description: Constructs a DSN string for PostgreSQL from environment variables, raising an error if required variables are missing.

methods.name: get_conn()
methods.description: Context manager yielding a psycopg connection, ensuring proper cleanup.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_one(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None)
methods.description: Fetches a single row from the database as a dictionary, or None if no rows match.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_all(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None)
methods.description: Fetches all matching rows from the database as a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: None execute(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None)
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement (like INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) and commits the transaction.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] execute_returning_one(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None)
methods.description: Executes a query expected to return a single row, returning it as a dictionary and raising an error if no row is returned.

ctags.name: execute
ctags.pattern: /^def execute(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None) -> None:$/

ctags.name: execute_returning_one
ctags.pattern: /^def execute_returning_one(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: fetch_all
ctags.pattern: /^def fetch_all(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: fetch_one
ctags.pattern: /^def fetch_one(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
